title: Review Router Config
description: Team routing configuration for the review-router GitHub Action.

orgs.description: Org-specific config sections. The action selects the section matching the repo's GitHub org at runtime.

users.description: GitHub username to Slack user ID mapping.

default_slack_channel.description: Fallback Slack channel ID used when a team has no channel configured.

teams.description: Team slug to config mapping. Slugs must match the GitHub team name used in CODEOWNERS.

enabled.description: Enable stale-PR Slack reminders on schedule events.

stale_hours.description: Only remind for PRs where the Ready for Review label was added at least this many hours ago. Default: 24.

enabled.description: Enable Slack reactions on notifications. When false or absent, no reactions are added.

approved.description: Slack emoji name added when a team member approves. Default: white_check_mark.

merged.description: Slack emoji name added when the PR is merged. Default: heavy_check_mark.

closed.description: Slack emoji name added when the PR is closed without merging. Default: no_entry_sign.

file_types.description: File extension to Slack emoji name mapping. Keys are extensions (e.g. 'py', 'ts') or special names ('dockerfile', 'github-actions').

NotificationIcons.description: Custom Slack emoji names used in notification messages. Defaults use standard Slack emojis. Override with custom emojis (see assets/slack-emojis/).

header.description: Header icon for notifications. Default: mag.

branch.description: Branch icon in footer. Default: twisted_rightwards_arrows.

commits.description: Commits icon in footer. Default: arrow_heading_up.

files.description: Files icon in footer. Default: page_facing_up.

labels.description: Labels icon in footer. Default: label.

auto_label.description: Automatically add the ready-label to PRs opened by dependabot[bot].
Automatically add the ready-label and external-contribution label to PRs from forks.

label.description: GitHub label name applied to the PR (e.g. 'Needs Review: Applications').

slack_channel.description: Slack channel ID for notifications. Empty string to skip.
